about: Where the typed lines of chapter 2 for newcomers, pages 3 to 5, actually reach on round 4 film stills: the leftmost, rightmost and topmost pixel brighter than the threshold (all three colour channels) in a band of rows round each line. Measured by the page timing helper (log 35) on working files redesign/round4-film/stills (frames drawn by render-paper-film.mjs in round 4, 1080 x 1920), with the code below; the stills themselves are not copied (too big).
method: band = still[rows]; bright = band.min(axis=2) > threshold; left/right = first/last column with a bright pixel; top = first row with one
